ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a quadrilateral, with a horizontal side at the top, labeled 10; a shorter horizontal side at the bottom, labeled 4; and a vertical side on the right, labeled 8. There are right-angle marks at both the upper right corner and the lower right corner, indicating that the right vertical side is respectively perpendicular to the upper and lower horizontal sides, so the upper and lower horizontal sides are parallel, and the whole figure can be regarded as a right trapezoid. Reasoning: The two parallel bases of the right trapezoid are respectively 10 and 4, and the height is the right vertical side 8. The area formula for a trapezoid is A = ((b1 + b2) / 2) × h. Substituting gives A = ((10 + 4) / 2) × 8 = 14 / 2 × 8 = 7 × 8 = 56.
